status={}
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook('/workspace/inputs/230215_Trio_Status.xlsx', data_only=True); ws=wb.active
for r in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
    if r[0] is not None:

wb.close()
files=sorted(glob.glob('/workspace/inputs/CHIP_DP10_GQ20_PASS/*.xlsx'))
def sid_of(fn):
    name=os.path.basename(fn).replace('230209_Exome_GRCh38_CHIP_','').replace('.xlsx','')
    m=re.match(r'"'^('"\\d+)[-_]',name)
    if m: return m.group(1)
    m=re.match(r'"'^(SRR'"\\d+)',name)
    return m.group(1) if m else name
car=[f for f in files if status.get(sid_of(f))=='Carrier']

counter=collections.Counter(); rows=[]
for f in car:
    wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(f, read_only=False, data_only=True); ws=wb.active
    for r in ws.iter_rows(min_row=3, values_only=True):
        vaf=r[9]

        v=float(vaf)

            so=str(r[13]); eff=str(r[14]); gene=str(r[12]); pos=str(r[0]); zyg=str(r[4]); chrompos=r[0]
